title: 약혼녀가 찾던 구세주 의사가 자신이 혐오하던 약혼자였다!여사장을 구한 그는 결혼증을 들고 찾아왔지만,그녀는 시골 출신이라며 파혼을 고집한다!
adapt: The 'you scorned the person who was secretly your savior' identity-reveal could carry an AI story where someone dismisses or distrusts an AI system out of prejudice, only to discover it was the very thing that saved them.
why: Not about AI, but its status-prejudice-then-reveal structure transfers to AI-misjudgment narratives; it's a timeless melodrama trope with no expiry marker.
